title: Unification of Bengal under Ilyas Shahi authority
detail: Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah consolidated major Bengal centers into a single sultanate framework, marking a durable shift toward unified regional sovereignty.

title: Independent position against Delhi pressure is sustained
detail: Military and political contest with the Delhi Sultanate did not reverse Bengal's separate trajectory, reinforcing the independent standing of the Bengal Sultanate.

title: Distinct coinage, court culture, and architecture develop
detail: Silver tanka minting networks, Persian-Bengali court practice, and major architectural projects became markers of a sovereign Bengal political culture.

title: A sovereign Bengal state tradition is established
detail: The Bengal Sultanate provided a durable precedent for regional statehood, shaping later administrative and political formations before early modern colonial transition.
